description: Search or browse ShopGoodwill.com — Goodwill's official online auction marketplace for secondhand clothing, shoes, accessories, and jewelry.

brand.description: Optional brand name to AND into the search text (e.g. `levis`, `coach`, `nike`). ShopGoodwill does not expose a structured brand facet — this is a keyword narrowing, not an exact filter.
brand.title: Brand keyword

buyNowOnly.description: Only include items with an active Buy-It-Now price (skip bid-only auctions).
buyNowOnly.title: Buy-it-now listings only

categoryId.description: Fashion category to browse or narrow by (mode=byCategory uses this as the primary filter; other modes use it as an optional narrowing filter). Includes both top-level departments and their live subcategories.
categoryId.title: Category

includeClosedAuctions.description: Search recently-ended (sold) listings instead of only live auctions — useful for sold-price research.
includeClosedAuctions.title: Include closed/ended auctions

itemIds.description: Numeric ShopGoodwill item IDs to fetch full detail for, e.g. `269254306`.
itemIds.title: Item IDs (mode=byItemIds)

pickupOnly.description: Only include items offered for local pickup (skip shipped-only listings).
pickupOnly.title: Local pickup listings only

priceMax.description: Drop items priced above this (current bid / buy-now price).
priceMax.title: Max price (USD)

priceMin.description: Drop items priced below this (current bid / buy-now price).
priceMin.title: Min price (USD)

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search (mode=search). Combine with `brand` / `sizeKeyword` to narrow results — ShopGoodwill has no separate brand/size facets, so these terms are ANDed into the search text.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sellerId.description: Numeric ShopGoodwill seller/store ID, e.g. `16` (Goodwill Industries of South Florida). Found in an item's `sellerId` output field or the store's URL.
sellerId.title: Seller ID (mode=bySeller)

sizeKeyword.description: Optional size to AND into the search text (e.g. `medium`, `size 8`, `xl`). ShopGoodwill does not expose a structured size facet on most categories — this is a keyword narrowing, not an exact filter.
sizeKeyword.title: Size keyword

title: ShopGoodwill Scraper Input
